description:
Return the period coverage (`data_min`/`data_max`, 'YYYY-MM') actually
cached for the given customs code(s) -- use before picking
`period_start`/`period_end` so you don't request an empty window.

items.description: A canonical customs code, TOTAL, or a supported residual spelling.

customs_codes.description: Customs code(s) to check coverage for. Omit for the overall store range.

name: get_data_range

data_max.description: The last month with data in the local store, over the codes' raw declarations.

data_min.description: The first month with data in the local store, over the codes' raw declarations (every definition).

selection.description: For each piece given (the basket request form), the coverage of its window -- separate from the raw base coverage above.

items.description:
The stored coverage of one piece: the months holding data inside its
window, so gaps between definitions stay visible.

from_month.description: The window's first month, ISO 'YYYY-MM'; null = the store coverage start.

to_month.description: The window's last month, ISO 'YYYY-MM'; null = the store coverage end.

windows.description: The months holding data inside the piece's window; an empty list means nothing is stored there.

data_max.description: The last month with data inside the window ('YYYY-MM').

data_min.description: The first month with data inside the window ('YYYY-MM').

title: Get Data Range
